sections.description:
Building a directory or classified ad website shouldn’t be complicated. Yet for many, finding a plugin that combines flexibility, ease of use, and powerful monetization options in one place feels impossible.

When managing listings, user submissions, and payment plans — you need a tool that’s simple to start with and scalable as your site grows.

That’s where aDirectory comes in. It’s a complete, modern, and intuitive WordPress directory plugin built for creating professional directory websites and classified ad platforms.

Whether it’s a business directory, property listing, restaurant guide, hotel directory, or classified ads portal — aDirectory offers everything you need to launch and grow with confidence.

Docs | Themes | Addons | Roadmap

Why Choose aDirectory?

Creating a scalable, high-performing WP Directory plugin shouldn’t be complicated or expensive. aDirectory is built for both beginners and developers — offering a robust, WordPress company directory plugin that delivers everything you need to launch and manage a thriving listing site.

From frontend listing submissions, advanced filtering, OpenStreetMap integration, and customizable forms to flexible monetization options — it’s the all-in-one toolkit for building any type of business listing plugin WordPress site or WordPress classifieds plugin.

No coding? No problem. Customizable via Elementor, aDirectory comes packed with drag-and-drop controls, shortcodes, and widgets. Whether you’re creating a WordPress business directory plugin, a job listing plugin WordPress, or a WordPress membership directory plugin, aDirectory adapts to your vision effortlessly.

Core Features at a Glance

✔️ Multi-Directory Support
Create unlimited directories under one WordPress business listing plugin installation. Run business directories, job boards, property listings, event calendars, and classified ads website builder setups — each with unique custom fields and configurations.

✔️ Unlimited Custom Fields
Easily add text inputs, dropdowns, checkboxes, file uploads, URLs, ratings, and more to your WordPress directory listing plugin forms. Control the data you collect and how it’s displayed with complete freedom.

✔️ Frontend Submission & User Dashboard
Let visitors submit and manage listings through a sleek frontend dashboard. Ideal for business directory software platforms where users can track submissions, payments, and renewals without backend access.

✔️ OpenStreetMap
Display listings on built-in OpenStreetMap, enjoy location-based WordPress best directory plugin experiences without extra cost.

✔️ AJAX-Powered Search & Filters
Deliver instant, dynamic search results using AJAX-based filters by location, category, price, or custom fields — a must-have for any serious directory builder.

✔️ Listing Galleries & Video Listings
Let users showcase image sliders and embed video tours. Perfect for classified ads website builder platforms, and business showcases.

✔️ Email Notifications & Social Sharing
Automatic alerts for submissions, approvals, and expirations — with social share options for Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and more.

✔️ SEO-Optimized & Translation Ready
Fine-tune meta titles and descriptions for every listing. Fully compatible with popular SEO tools and multilingual plugins like WPML and Polylang — making it a top-tier WordPress business directory solution.

Monetization Features

✔️ Paid Listings & Pay Per Submit
Charge users to post listings or submit them individually, monetizing both free and premium WordPress business directory plugin setups.

✔️ Featured Listings & Badges
Promote listings with ‘Featured’, ‘Verified’, and ‘Popular’ badges, boosting visibility in search results on your best directory plugin WordPress-powered website.

✔️ Pricing Plans & Subscriptions (Pro)
Offer flexible plans with one-time or recurring payment options via WooCommerce and Stripe — ideal for WordPress classifieds plugin setups and WP classifieds plugin-powered marketplaces.

✔️ Coupons & Discounts (Pro)
Attract new customers with promotional coupons for listing plans — a great feature for growing any directory plugin, WordPress free or premium installation.

Available Premium Addons

  • Stripe Payment Gateway
  • WooCommerce Integration
  • Pricing Plans & Subscriptions
  • Compare Listings
  • Business Hours Display
  • Social Login Integration
  • Mailchimp Integration
  • Verification Badge

  • Claim Listing Addon

  • More on the way

These tools enhance your website builder directory projects, giving you the flexibility to run everything from local business directories to member directory WordPress plugin-powered membership platforms.

Developer-Friendly

✔️ Custom Hooks & Filters
Easily extend the WordPress listing plugin functionality using WordPress action and filter hooks.

✔️ Template Override System
Customize the look and feel of your WordPress directory listing plugin without touching core files.

✔️ WPML Compatible
Build multilingual, location-based directories with ease, supporting business directory WP plugin installations for global audiences.

aDirectory Niche Specific Directory Themes

  • Elementor: Full support for drag-and-drop page building with aDirectory widgets.
  • OpenStreetMap: Free mapping option for displaying listing locations.
  • WooCommerce: Use WooCommerce to process payments for listings and pricing packages.
  • Mailchimp: Build and manage your subscriber lists.
  • Stripe: Secure payment gateway for listing submissions and subscriptions.

These integrations turn aDirectory into the best WordPress directory plugin for both beginners and advanced users.

Privacy Policy

aDirectory – Directory Listing WordPress Plugin uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org or install it directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.

  2. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for “aDirectory”, and click Install Now.

  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

  4. Navigate to aDirectory Settings to configure general options, submission forms, and monetization settings.

  5. Create listing categories and locations from aDirectory > Categories and aDirectory > Locations.

  6. Use shortcodes or Elementor widgets to display your directories on any page.

Done — your directory site is live and ready to start earning!
sections.faq:
Q. Can I run multiple directories on one website using aDirectory?

Yes! aDirectory allows you to create unlimited directories under a single WordPress installation — each with its own categories, custom fields, and settings.

Do I need a Google Maps API key?

No. aDirectory comes with free, built-in OpenStreetMap integration for interactive maps.

Can visitors submit listings from the frontend?

Absolutely. aDirectory includes an intuitive frontend submission form so users can easily add, edit, and renew their listings from their personal dashboard.

Is aDirectory compatible with Elementor?

Yes. aDirectory works seamlessly with Elementor— with dedicated widgets and blocks for listing grids, search forms, categories, and more.

Q. How do I monetize my directory site with aDirectory?

You can charge for listings, offer featured listing positions, and integrate Stripe or WooCommerce payments with the premium add-ons.

Q. Does it support RTL languages and multilingual sites?

Yes. aDirectory is translation-ready and fully compatible with WPML. It also supports right-to-left languages like Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian.

Is coding knowledge required to use this plugin?

Not at all. aDirectory is beginner-friendly and built for non-coders. You can customize forms, fields, pricing, and layouts with simple visual interfaces and Elementor support.
